synthesis:draft.headline: Prolonged high prices in SA on 2026-07-30 with a five‑minute peak of $4,981.0 and demand lower in the afternoon half‑hour containing the peak
summary: Peak five‑minute RRP was $4,981.0 at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (16:35 UTC).
There were 214 five‑minute intervals meeting the analysis threshold of $300.0/MWh during the episode.
Mean five‑minute RRP over the window was $416.71/MWh.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five‑minute price peak was 1472.82 MW and net interchange at that interval was -82.59 (net import into SA1).
Operational demand in the half‑hour containing the peak (ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z) was 1466.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 2173.0 MW.
AEMO published a market notice reporting a City West transformer and circuit‑breaker trip on 30/07/2026 [c1].
AEMO published a market notice reporting a short‑notice outage of the Belalie‑Davenport 275kV line on 30/07/2026 [c2].
AEMO published a market notice reporting a planned outage (rescheduled) affecting Tailem_Bnd–South_East 275kV line [c3].

possible_explanations.statement: Constraint or interconnector availability changes around the afternoon may have narrowed import/export capability and so might be associated with the high prices (AEMO reported a short‑notice outage of the Belalie‑Davenport line and a planned/rescheduled outage affecting Tailem_Bnd–South_East) [c2] [c3].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the interconnector limit time series and constraint binding records for the afternoon/evening intervals and check whether interconnector limits were reduced or constraint equations were binding during the high‑price five‑minute intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: Reductions in observed local generation output might have tightened available local supply and could be consistent with the price pattern (several units show large SCADA decreases in the day).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review unit outage/availability declarations, forced outage reports and rebid/offer stacks for the named units to determine whether the SCADA changes were outages, economic dispatching, or other events.

possible_explanations.statement: A supply–demand tightness scenario (high mean RRP and many intervals above the threshold) might be present during the episode.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine the offer stacks and dispatch merit order during the high‑price intervals to see whether low‑cost capacity was unavailable or constrained off and whether dispatch required high‑priced offers to be dispatched.
